items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...How did Bing Crosby and Nino Remay get into that picture with you? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, because Olga San Juan, I knew Olga San Juan when she was a baby.

ctx.x: Eddie Cano. He had a combination bass, timbales, a vocalist, and a bongo player and about five or six pieces; but very good.
Okay. What else do you remember about Los Angeles? How did Bing Crosby and Nino Remay get into that picture with you?
Well, because Olga San Juan, I knew Olga San Juan when she was a baby.
